title: Data Analyst
source: O*NET Online (15-2051.01 - Business Intelligence Analysts; 15-2051.00 - Data Scientists) & SFIA 8 (Business Intelligence BINT Level 2-3)
description: Collects, cleans, models, and interprets data to uncover actionable insights, build predictive reporting metrics, and empower executive business decision-making.

rubric.1: Novice: Understands basic terminology, spreadsheet rows/columns, and simple calculation syntax. Requires guided walkthroughs for all tasks.
rubric.2: Advanced Beginner: Can write basic SELECT queries, perform standard VLOOKUP/FILTER formulas, and create simple charts with documentation reference.
rubric.3: Competent (Job-Ready Baseline): Autonomously writes multi-table SQL joins, builds clean Pandas data-cleaning pipelines, designs interactive BI dashboards, and documents methodology.
rubric.4: Proficient: Optimizes slow analytical queries, builds robust dimensional data models (star schema), automates scheduled reporting, and communicates technical insights to executives.
rubric.5: Expert: Architects enterprise data warehousing policies, designs predictive statistical models, establishes organization-wide data governance, and mentors junior analysts.

requirements.description: Proficiency in data cleaning, nested lookup formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH), Pivot Tables, dynamic arrays, and structured modeling.
Writing complex SELECT queries, inner/outer JOINs, GROUP BY aggregations, window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG/LEAD), subqueries, and CTEs.
Using Python with Pandas and NumPy for missing value imputation, data type casting, string manipulation, datetime operations, and outlier detection.
Descriptive statistics (mean, median, standard deviation, IQR), correlation matrices, distribution skewness analysis, and basic hypothesis testing.

evidence_types: Interactive Power BI or Tableau public workbook
requirements.description: Designing user-centric interactive dashboards using Power BI or Tableau with DAX/calculated fields, drill-through filters, and star schema modeling.
Translating technical analytical findings into clear business narratives with actionable recommendations, executive summaries, and visual storytelling.
Understanding PII regulations (GDPR, CCPA), dataset anonymization, citation of data sources, and avoiding algorithmic reporting bias.

evidence_types: Public GitHub repository with comprehensive README
requirements.description: Using Git for version control, structuring clean data science repositories with virtual environments, requirements.txt, and Markdown READMEs.

project_templates.title: Retail Customer Churn & Retention SQL Analysis
project_templates.brief: Perform in-depth SQL cohort analysis on a public 100,000-transaction retail dataset. Extract customer lifetime value (LTV), identify high-risk churn indicators using window functions, and construct a Star Schema data model.
deliverables: Documented SQL script repository with schema DDL and analytical CTEs
Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD) in DBML or PNG format
Executive Markdown summary highlighting 3 key retention drivers
project_templates.evidence_output: Public GitHub repository with documented queries, database setup instructions, and executive markdown findings.

project_templates.title: Executive Sales & Product Performance BI Dashboard
project_templates.brief: Clean and transform raw multi-source CSV files using Python/Pandas, then build an interactive Power BI or Tableau dashboard featuring dynamic filtering, YoY growth metrics, and customer segment drill-downs.
deliverables: Jupyter Notebook detailing data cleaning, handling missing values, and aggregation
Interactive Power BI / Tableau public dashboard link with 3 distinct view tabs
Slide deck (5 slides, PDF) with business narrative and strategic recommendations
project_templates.evidence_output: Live interactive BI public link accompanied by GitHub repository hosting Python cleaning scripts, data dictionary, and executive slide deck.
